summary.zh: 用 ES6+ 特性写出更清晰的 JS
summary.en: Modern ES6+ patterns for cleaner JavaScript

description.zh: 整理 async/await、解构、展开、模块、迭代器和函数式写法，替换旧式回调与冗余代码。适合重构遗留 JavaScript，或在新项目里统一编码习惯。
description.en: Covers async/await, destructuring, spread, modules, iterators, and functional patterns to replace callback-heavy code. Use it when refactoring legacy JavaScript or setting conventions in a new project.
